The Descent Awaits

You are the party's only healer: you choose who gets the shield, when your damage-dealers pull, and who lives.
Walk too close to a pack and it pulls on its own.
Some doors stay shut until a switch, rune or puzzle opens them.

Raids

Erase all gold, gear, talents, ability ranks, stat training, team XP and keystone progress? This can't be undone.

Paused

The fight paused while you were away.

Leave the descent?

The fight is paused. Gold and gear you've already picked up are kept, and you earn team XP for how much of the descent you cleared, the same as a wipe. You won't get boss rewards or credit for clearing this keystone.

Victory

Gear, Stats & Shop

Equip a piece, or tick pieces to sell or reroll them. Q1–Q5 scales stats from 70% to 130%. Green and red numbers compare with what you are wearing.

Character stats

Inventory

Talents

One pick per tier. Unlock tiers with gold, in order (later tiers cost more). Click a different option to swap, or your current pick to clear it.

Ability Ranks

Ranks II–V make an ability stronger. Level gates unlock each rank and gold buys it; once bought you can switch between any rank you own for free. Rank V is a capstone.
